research_insight_text_link.research_insight_description: Chia Network is researching methods for extending a proof of space blockchain and methods for extending a proof of space time blockchain, including grinding resistant consensus in a proof of space based blockchain and pooling in a proof of space based blockchain via singletons. It also develops a method for securing private structured databases within a public blockchain, a method for blockchain gaming based on a state channel, a bridge protocol for interoperable blockchain networks, and consensus layer architecture, covering storage based consensus, interoperability, data privacy, gaming, and scalability.

product.name: Chia Blockchain
product.description: A blockchain platform using Proofs of Space and Time consensus to provide secure, energy-efficient, and decentralized ledger technology.

product.name: Chialisp
product.description: A native programming language for the Chia blockchain designed for writing smart contracts with simplicity and broad functionality.

product.name: Chia Wallet and Farming Application
product.description: An official application that functions as a lightweight wallet and farming tool for managing XCH and participating in network consensus.

product.name: Chia Asset Tokens (CAT)
product.description: A tokenization framework on the Chia blockchain for creating and managing digital representations of physical and digital assets.

product.name: Chia Vaults
product.description: On-chain smart contract-based custody solution for securing digital assets with multi-user and multi-approver controls.

product.name: Chia Offers
product.description: A peer-to-peer asset trading protocol enabling direct, on-chain exchange of assets between two parties without intermediaries.
